title: zard.preset.json
description: A zard/ui design system preset. Use it wherever --preset is accepted, in place of a short code, when the theme carries hand-edited colours that a short code cannot represent.

$schema.description: This file's schema. Keeping it lets your editor validate and complete the fields below.

version.description: The preset format. Bumped only when a field changes meaning.

name.description: A label for this preset. Shown in reports; never affects what is written.

baseColor.description: The neutral tone the theme is built on. The valid values are the ones the registry publishes in presets.json.

theme.description: The accent colour. `neutral` means no accent — the primary stays the base tone. Its tokens are derived over the base tone, so the same accent works on every one of them.

radius.description: The corner radius step, which becomes the value of --radius.

icons.description: The icon set the components are written against. Validated against the registry's icons.json.

darkMode.description: `class` installs the theme script and provider; `off` ships light mode only.

rtl.description: Whether the project reads right to left.

colors.description: Token overrides, applied last. This is the reason a preset file exists: hand-edited colours do not fit a short code.

tokens.description: CSS custom properties without the leading --, e.g. `primary`, `sidebar-ring`.
